name: Tet Run Mien Nam 2027
short_description: Tet Run Mien Nam is on Sunday 24 January 2027 at Vinhomes Grand Park in Ho Chi Minh City, over 21 km only.
ai_summary: Tet Run Mien Nam 2027 is the southern race of the Tet Run pair, organised by Green Running Company, and is held on 24 January 2027 at Vinhomes Grand Park, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh City. The expo is on 23 January. The only distance is 21 km. The organiser says Tet Run Mien Bac is held the same day at Vinhomes Ocean Park 2 in Hanoi.

core_facts.organizer: Green Running Company (Cong ty Co phan Duong Chay Xanh)

faqs.question: What are the age limit and cut-off at Tet Run Mien Nam 2027?
faqs.answer: The 21 km is for runners aged 16 and over, with a 3 hour 30 minute cut-off. The early-bird price on Pace8 is VND 678,000, and that entry has no finisher shirt. The course map and race kit details are marked "to be updated".

faqs.question: Can I transfer my Tet Run Mien Nam 2027 entry?
faqs.answer: Entry fees are not refunded for any reason. Personal details can be changed free and entries transferred for VND 100,000 until the end of 18 December 2026. The expo is on 23 January 2027 and race day is 24 January 2027.
